heading: Tuesday, August 5, 2025
topLine: 3 model releases: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.1, Google Genie 3 and OpenAI gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b.

items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.1
items.summary: Claude Opus 4.1 is an upgrade to Opus 4 aimed at agentic tasks, real-world coding and reasoning, with Anthropic reporting 74.5% on SWE-bench Verified. It is priced the same as Opus 4 and available in paid Claude plans, Claude Code, the API, Amazon Bedrock and Vertex AI.

items.headline: Google DeepMind announces Genie 3 world model
items.summary: Genie 3 is a general-purpose world model that generates interactive environments from text prompts. Users can navigate them in real time at 24 frames per second and 720p, and the worlds stay consistent for a few minutes. It launched as a limited research preview.

items.headline: OpenAI releases open-weight gpt-oss models
items.summary: gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b are open-weight mixture-of-experts reasoning models under the Apache 2.0 license, OpenAI's first open-weight language models since GPT-2. OpenAI says the 120b model approaches o4-mini on core reasoning benchmarks and runs on a single 80 GB GPU; the 20b model fits in 16 GB of memory.
